info.title: Instinct Router API
info.description: Version 1 pricing and opt-in user-wallet execution API. Pricing quotes remain read-only and cannot authorize execution. Only configured Base native ETH to canonical Base USDC and explicitly pinned Relay Base native ETH or USDC to canonical Solana USDC are executable. Reverse Solana and other-provider execution remain blocked. Source-only user-wallet trade signing; independent finalized destination proof and durable funding/order/delivery replay protection. Quote/preflight, historical receipts and mocks do not establish a completed live user trade. The server never signs or broadcasts. Wallet proof is distinct from transaction approval. ETA is configured unmeasured policy. Strict bounded JSON, no unknown request fields or arbitrary queries; duplicate security headers are rejected. Browser app keys require exact allowed Origin; server Bearer keys require no Origin. No cookies.

post.description: Progressive read-only quote comparison over NDJSON. Same strict QuoteInput and app credentials. No Idempotency-Key or automatic retry. START then zero to 128 provisional CANDIDATE events then COMPLETE or ERROR. Every line binds apiVersion, requestId, appId and the exact external request with monotonic sequence starting at zero. COMPLETE contains the normal app-owned stored quote snapshot. Require clean EOF after COMPLETE; never treat an early candidate as a winner or execution authorization. Disconnect cancels service work; slow readers and streams have bounded queue, byte and time budgets.

post.description: Authenticated read-only observation stream for the original submitted hash. Empty body. Ownership is verified before headers and the wallet session is checked before every proof and update. START, UPDATE*, END or ERROR; all frames bind executionId, requestId, appId and a contiguous zero-based sequence. Updates are flushed immediately after independent evidence checks; display progress never authorizes a wallet action or bypasses finality. One stream per app/wallet/execution. Sequential 250 ms target checks share ordinary operation quotas. Disconnect stops observation, never a transaction. No idempotency keys. No guaranteed chain-to-display latency.

200.description: NDJSON lines: max 120 seconds, 1024 frames, 256 KiB per line, 8 MiB total, eight queued frames and one-second blocked-write limit. Require clean EOF after END/ERROR. Ingress must disable response buffering.

post.description: Read-only public balance using operator-vetted configured RPC catalogs only. App authentication and exact browser Origin are required; wallet ownership proof is not required. EVM native/ERC20 and Solana native/classic SPL/Token2022 are supported on configured chains. Native and token amounts remain exact decimal strings; Solana token accounts are owner/mint/program bound and summed without duplicates (maximum128 accounts). Unsafe-number native SOL responses fail closed. No caller RPC URL, decimals, calldata or transaction is accepted. Reads are bounded to5seconds; unavailable evidence is never converted to zero. This public owned amount can include frozen SPL balances and does not include Token2022 confidential holdings. It does not authorize execution.

RelayOrderMetadata.description: Optional metadata for the exact pinned Relay recipe; returned as part of the immutable hashed action, never accepted as caller-supplied execution authority.

ExecutionSupport.description: Configured wallet execution admission, separate from price discovery. Locally reconstructed recipes coexist with an explicit provider-managed EVM/Solana profile. Tokens are admitted by native/ERC20/SPL class, including custom addresses, and still need fresh liquidity, token behavior, balance, fee and transaction checks. Provider metadata and API callers cannot silently grant execution authority.

ProviderManagedRoute.description: Explicit operator opt-in: official Relay constructs DEX/funding transactions and associates payouts. Fresh wallet/asset/amount/expiry/fee bindings, source simulation and canonical recipient credit remain mandatory. This is provider trust, not independent decoding of arbitrary DEX calldata.

serialized.description: Full unsigned legacy or v0 transaction wire with one zero signature; never a message-only encoding.

feePayer.description: Exact source sender and original transaction fee payer; a native sentinel is not a wallet.

blockhash.description: Exact recent blockhash bound to the original reviewed transaction.

preparedSlot.description: Exact slot recorded by the original provider-managed transaction validation.

lastValidBlockHeight.description: Exact original transaction blockhash expiry height.

finalizedSlot.description: Independently observed finalized slot, at least preparedSlot.

finalizedBlockHeight.description: Independently observed finalized block height strictly greater than lastValidBlockHeight.

finalizedBlockHash.description: Canonical base58 encoding of exactly 32 bytes; independently verified by the server.

observedAtMs.description: Server observation time at or after the plan expiry; new expiry decisions require fresh evidence, not a user timer.

minimumLedgerSlot.description: Retained-ledger lower bound no greater than preparedSlot.

firstAvailableBlock.description: Earliest available block no greater than preparedSlot; history must cover the original preparation slot.

latestSignatureSlot.description: Independently verified latest fee-payer signature slot strictly below preparedSlot. Unverified empty history is insufficient.

SolanaClaimExpiryEvidence.description: Independently server-verified finalized expired-blockhash and retained-history absence proof bound to the original initial unsubmitted provider-managed Solana claim. Permits CLAIMED or RECOVERY_REQUIRED to become EXPIRED only with no submissions, receipts or prior expiry proof. Never a user-timer decision, unverified empty-history inference, or release of a submitted transaction. Existing authenticated execution GET, active lookup and refresh may invoke verification; there is no new endpoint. The server validates all cross-field, original-plan, freshness and canonical-chain relationships.

balanceRaw.description: Exact public owned base-unit amount bounded to uint256. Frozen SPL accounts count; Token2022 confidential holdings are excluded. Not a guarantee of spendability.

observedAtMs.description: Server read observation in Unix milliseconds, not a wallet RTT or settlement timestamp.
